responsibility: Implements the global diagnostic_context facade used by most GCC code through language-independent helper functions. It owns global_dc and provides the variadic wrappers for verbatim output, warnings, errors, notes, pedwarn-like severities, fatal and internal errors, along with RAII group and nesting helpers, translating these convenience APIs into diagnostic_context::diagnostic_impl calls and enforcing the stderr-safety rules for machine-readable output modes.
